To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve had the opportunity to collaborate with Siddharth Menon on several cross-functional security initiatives at VirtuSafe Technologies. As a skip-level manager, our interactions are occasional but meaningful, often centered on aligning security protocols with product development timelines. Siddharth’s work consistently bridges technical rigor with business priorities, ensuring compliance without compromising innovation.  

Siddharth’s expertise in application security and compliance stands out. He recently led the SOC2 audit for a flagship SaaS product, coordinating with legal and engineering teams to resolve gaps in data encryption and access controls. His attention to detail ensured the audit passed with minimal remediation, avoiding potential revenue loss. Beyond compliance, he proactively designs IAM frameworks that balance user flexibility with enterprise-grade security, a challenge that requires both technical depth and stakeholder diplomacy.  

A memorable example occurred during a penetration test for a client’s API infrastructure. Siddharth identified a zero-day vulnerability in third-party dependencies, escalating the risk to the CISO and spearheading a rapid patch deployment. His ability to translate technical findings into actionable strategies prevented a potential breach. Similarly, his threat modeling sessions for new products have consistently anticipated edge cases, embedding security into the development lifecycle rather than treating it as an afterthought.  

Siddharth’s work ethic is defined by curiosity and adaptability. He approaches problems with a methodical mindset, often asking questions that uncover hidden risks. His contributions to VirtuSafe’s security posture are both measurable and foundational.  

Should you require further insights, please reach out.  
Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[VirtuSafe Technologies]
